F-35 Integrated Power Package
(L:IPPMasterSwitch, bool) Master switch ON OFF (L:ICC1Switch, bool) Inverter Converter Controller 1 ON OFF (L:ICC2Switch, bool) Inverter Converter Controller 2 ON OFF (L:IPPModeSelector, enum) IPP Mode 0=OFF 1=AUTO 2=STARTER (L:IPPCabinPressureSelector, enum) Cabin Pressure Selector 0=DUMP 1=NORM 2=ALTN (L:IPPEmergencyShutOff, bool) 0 = system on 1 = shutdown
